@@ -1,17 +1,20 @@
 [[ext:za128rs]]
 === ext:za128rs[] Extension for Reservation-Set Size
 
+[[norm:za128rs_res_set_req]]
 The ext:za128rs[] extension requires that the reservation sets used by the
 instructions in the ext:zalrsc[] extension be contiguous, naturally aligned, and at
 most 128 bytes in size.
 
 [[ext:za64rs]]
 === ext:za64rs[] Extension for Reservation-Set Size
 
+[[norm:za64rs_res_set_req]]
 The ext:za64rs[] extension requires that the reservation sets used by the
 instructions in the ext:zalrsc[] extension be contiguous, naturally aligned, and at
 most 64 bytes in size.
 
+[[norm:za64rs_implies_za128rs]]
 The ext:za64rs[] extension implies the ext:za128rs[] extension.
 
 //

@@ -1,5 +1,6 @@
 [[ext:zic64b]]
 === ext:zic64b[] Extension for 64-byte Cache Blocks
 
+[[norm:zic64b_cache_block_size]]
 If the ext:zic64b[] extension is implemented, then cache blocks must be
 64 bytes in size, naturally aligned in the address space.

@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 [[ext:ziccamoa]]
 === ext:ziccamoa[] Extension for Main Memory Atomics
 
+[[norm:ziccamoa_amo_pma]]
 If the ext:ziccamoa[] extension is implemented, then main memory regions with
 both the coherence and cacheability PMAs must provide AMOArithmetic-level PMA
 support as defined in <<sec:amo-pma>>.

@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 [[ext:ziccamoc]]
 === ext:ziccamoc[] Extension for Main Memory Compare-and-Swap
 
+[[norm:ziccamoc_casq_pma]]
 If the ext:ziccamoc[] extension is implemented, then main memory regions with
 both the coherence and cacheability PMAs must provide AMOCASQ-level PMA support
 as defined in <<sec:amo-pma>>.

@@ -5,11 +5,13 @@ NOTE: This extension was ratified alongside the RVA20U64 profile.
 This chapter supplies an operational definition for the extension
 and adds expository material.
 
+[[norm:ziccif_if_atomicity]]
 If the ext:ziccif[] extension is implemented, main memory regions with both the
 coherence and cacheability PMAs must support instruction fetch, and any
 instruction fetches of naturally aligned power-of-2 sizes of at most
 `min(ILEN,XLEN)` bits are atomic.
 
+[[norm:ziccif_fetch_mechanism]]
 An implementation with the ext:ziccif[] extension fetches instructions in a manner
 equivalent to the following state machine.
 
@@ -59,6 +61,7 @@ Because ILEN must be at least the width of the instruction being modified,
 a lower bound on `M` can be inferred from the instruction's width and XLEN.
 ====
 
+[[norm:ziccif_pma_application]]
 Memory protection and executability PMAs are applied only to bytes that are
 not discarded by this algorithm.

 [[ext:zicclsm]]
 === ext:zicclsm[] Extension for Main Memory Misaligned Accesses
 
+[[norm:zicclsm_misaligned_support]]
 If the ext:zicclsm[] extension is implemented, then misaligned loads and stores
 to main memory regions with both the coherence and cacheability PMAs must be
 supported.

 If the ext:ziccrse[] extension is implemented, then main memory regions with both
 the coherence and cacheability PMAs must support the RsrvEventual PMA.
